name: Private Desk
tagline: Analyses material too sensitive to hand to an ordinary chat window
description: Some documents cannot reasonably be pasted into a general assistant, so the analysis simply never gets done at all. This carries out the work inside a sealed hardware enclave instead: the material is encrypted on your own side, and the environment proves what it is running before a result is accepted.
author: useprismnetwork
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
